Bill.BriefDescription: Creating a business and occupation tax exemption for chemotherapy and anticancer drugs dispensed pursuant to prescription.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to business and occupation tax exemption forchemotherapy and anticancer drugs dispensed pursuant to prescription;and adding a new section to chapter 82.04 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: This chapter does not apply to amounts derived from sales ofchemotherapy and anticancer drugs for infusion or injection for humanuse pursuant to a prescription sold at the then current federal rate bylicensed physicians. The federal rate means the rate at or below whichthe federal government or its agents reimburse providers forprescription drugs administered to cancer patients as provided for inthe medicare, part B, drugs average sales price information resource aspublished by the United States department of health and human services,or any successor index thereto.
